player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} achi. Ami Memory Game khelachi.
Ami lakha achi bahu jugal cardke boardre khuntkhan, amar birodhike tike.
Ami palare, dui cardke flip khanir jonn, pratham ar ditiya carder saf ar kolom numberkhan lekhan '[0 1 1 0]' emon, jekhane pratham card 0 safre ar 1 kolomre achi, ar ditiya card 1 safre ar 0 kolomre achi.
Jodi dui card milaye, ami ek point paye ar cardgulo mukh uthaye thake. Jodi na mile, cardgulo mukh niche firiye deye, uda. '.'.
Khela ses hole jokhon sab jugal milaye jay.
